name: LLM7.io
short: Budget OpenAI-compatible router across dozens of hosted models, with a permanent free-token tier.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free API token: 100,000 tokens/day over a rolling 24h window, 1 req/s, 60 req/min and 250 req/h; free-token quotas may be reduced under fair-use controls.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Dynamic token allowance across the billing month, 25 req/s, 1,500 req/min, 15,000 req/h, JSON mode, function calling, and Pro-tier models.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.notes: Top up from $5; paid access unlocks Pro models with usage-billed pricing (e.g. DeepSeek $1.11/$3.33 per 1M).
